Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

3) PO / billing: you mentioned a PO process. Can you confirm PO contact, expected PO lead time, and standard payment terms (Net30/Net45)? If you have a vendor onboarding form, please send it and we’ll fill it out.

4) Timeline: you mentioned a target pilot in late July — I propose this mutual action plan:
  - This week: vendor paperwork + security review
  - Next week: pilot kickoff (sandbox access)
  - Week of Jul 27: pilot evaluation

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Pack.pdf, NetTerms-Redwood-v2.docx

If helpful, I can pull together a short stakeholder map and a one-page mutual action plan for signatures. Who should I send that to?

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week if I haven’t heard back.

Best,
